name: positive_valid_fee_variance
description: A genuine fee-variance case, matching the scenario the live batch injects for fee_variance orders. Merchant expected a flat 2% fee (Rs.20.00); aggregator charged 2% + GST (Rs.23.60). Settlement is internally consistent (gross - fee_charged = settled) and the LLM's proposed actual_fee agrees with the payout's fee_charged. Guard accepts.
